text: Objectives The program in Chinese Language and Literature provides students with basic theory and knowledge of Chinese language and to equip them with good skills in Chinese listening, speaking, reading, and writing. The program covers subjects of Chinese traditional culture, arts, philosophy, contemporary Chinese politics, and economic and legal systems in China. Students from the program will have a good employment opportunity in government agencies, corporations, media and cultural institutions or in related fields that are involved with China. Students can easily apply for further degree program in China if they plan so.Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice.Degree Awarded A Bachelor of Art is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation.Main Courses (Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced) Comprehensive Chinese, Oral Chinese, Listening Chinese, (Intermediate, Advanced) Writing, (Elementary, Intermediate) Reading
